verdict.rationale: Notte is API-first. It documents a Bearer-token REST API, including an agent-start endpoint, plus programmatically controlled sessions, scripts deployable as API endpoints, a CLI, and an MCP server described as giving agents access to 'the entire Notte ecosystem'. The live-view URL is also exposed in session output. However, nothing explicitly claims or shows UI/API parity, and no machine-readable OpenAPI spec was found. Missing for 10: an explicit parity statement or a full API reference covering every console feature (vault, identity and profile management, templates, replays, account and billing settings), a published OpenAPI spec, and independent hands-on corroboration.
